mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (name, slug, summary, description, cover_url, github_url, demo_url, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{githubUrl}, #{demoUrl}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM projects p
INNER JOIN project_skills ps ON p.id = ps.project_id
p.status = 1
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ps.skill_id = #{skillId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE status = 1
SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
